title: Purpose Key Grant V1
description: The Backend's response to an authenticated SDK session asking for content-identity purpose keys (ruling D1; docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md sections 3, 12, 18). It carries ONLY the two derived purpose keys of one tenant key version, never the tenant master. SECRET: example_id_key and example_version_key are key material. They MUST never be logged, cached on disk, echoed in errors, exported or forwarded; SDKs hold them in memory only and redact them from every rendering. Every string pattern in this file ends with the portable end anchor (?![\s\S]) instead of $ (see content_identity_v1_schema.json).

tenant_id.description: The Backend's exact tenant id (enterprise_tenants.id), byte for byte: it is bound into the HKDF info that derived these keys.

kid.description: Public key id of the tenant key version these keys belong to. Not secret.

example_id_key.x-privacy-note: SECRET key material. Never log, cache on disk, echo in an error, export or retransmit this value; hold it in memory only.
example_id_key.description: K_example_id: 32 bytes as 64 lowercase hex characters. SECRET key material. Never log, cache on disk, echo in an error, export or retransmit this value; hold it in memory only.

example_version_key.x-privacy-note: SECRET key material. Never log, cache on disk, echo in an error, export or retransmit this value; hold it in memory only.
example_version_key.description: K_example_ver: 32 bytes as 64 lowercase hex characters. SECRET key material. Never log, cache on disk, echo in an error, export or retransmit this value; hold it in memory only.

encoding.description: Encoding of the two key fields. Only 'hex' exists; a consumer MUST reject anything else rather than guess.
